title: 第13章 战林霸天第14章 大海苏醒
content_zh:
他直接将叶祈安拉到一边，小声说道：“臭小子，这个女人是怎么回事？”
“她说是你推荐要加入苍澜学院的？”
“还有你去什么地方了？”
“嗯，你带酒回来了？”
这一连串的问题让叶祈安不知道该先回答哪一个？
不由得苦笑说道：“长老，您先别着急，容我慢慢跟你说。”
经过一番解释之后，慕容长老这才对沈凝霜放下警惕。
“你小子...藏着掖着这么一个美娇妻，怎么？是想着金窝藏娇？！”
叶祈安连忙嘘声说道。
“嘘！长老，你不要乱说话，会死人的！”
看向沈凝霜只见她毫无情绪波动，还是一如既往的面无表情。
叶祈安心里暗道，看来在她心里，无论外界发生了什么都毫无波动。
“咳咳，长老，您是负责杂役弟子的，能不能让她也加入苍澜学院？”
叶祈安总不能让她一直待在这里没有身份吧？
难免会让人起疑。
慕容长老听后那眼神先是看了看叶祈安腰间的酒壶，一脸为难的说道。
“你小子是不是太看得起我了？”
“我只是管理杂役弟子的长老，在学院长老中地位最低，你这事....我可办不成。”
叶祈安自然是注意到了他在打的什么主意。
原来也是个酒鬼。

“长老，您放心，这事情只要您办成了，酒管够。”
随后掏出腰间的一壶酒递给慕容长老。
慕容长老非常正经，身体却是很诚实的接过酒壶。
“额，这个，那个啊，没问题，小事情，诺，拿着。”
“直接去新生报到处领取宗门服饰即可。”
他从纳戒中再次拿出一枚令牌，与叶祈安手中那枚一模一样。
叶祈安见状嘴角微微抽搐，这长老是准备了多少个这样的令牌？
“对了差点忘记正事，昨晚众多我感知到其他弟子元气突然被抽空，汇聚的方向似乎在你这边。”
他猛的喝下一口酒，沉声说道。“但奇怪的是忽然这种迹象中断了。”
叶祈安听后双眼微眯，笑着回答。
“长老，您想多了，我不过是一个杂役弟子，怎么可能将其他弟子的元气抽空呢？”
慕容长老眯着眼睛笑道。
“哦是吗？”
“罢了，嗝~”
content_en:
He directly pulled Ye Qian aside and whispered: "You brat, what's going on with this woman?"
"She said you recommended joining Canglan College?"
"And where have you been?"
"Well, you brought wine back?"
This series of questions made Ye Qian not know which one to answer first?
He couldn't help but smile bitterly and said: "Elder, don't be anxious. Let me tell you slowly."
After some explanations, Elder Murong finally let down his guard against Shen Ningshuang.
"You kid...are hiding such a beautiful wife, what's the matter? Do you want to hide your love for her?!"
Ye Qian'an hurriedly hissed.
"Shh! Elder, don't talk nonsense, you will kill someone!"
Looking at Shen Ningshuang, he saw that she had no mood swings and was still expressionless as before.
Ye Qian thought to herself that it seemed that in her heart, no matter what happened in the outside world, there was no fluctuation.
"Ahem, elder, you are in charge of the handyman disciples. Can you let her join Canglan Academy?"
Ye Qian can't let her stay here without identity, right?
It will inevitably make people suspicious.
After hearing this, Elder Murong first looked at the wine bottle on Ye Qi'an's waist and said with an embarrassed look on his face.
"Do you think too highly of me?"
"I'm just an elder who manages the handyman disciples. I have the lowest status among the elders in the college. I can't do this... I can't do it."
Ye Qian naturally noticed what he was planning.
Turns out he's also an alcoholic.
"Elder, don't worry, as long as you can handle this matter, the wine will be enough."
Then he took out a bottle of wine from his waist and handed it to Elder Murong.
Elder Murong was very serious, but he took the wine pot very honestly.
"Uh, this, that, no problem, it's a small thing, No, take it."
"Just go directly to the freshman registration office to pick up the sect's clothing."
He took out another token from the ring, which was exactly the same as the one in Ye Qian's hand.
Ye Qi'an's mouth twitched slightly when he saw this. How many such tokens had the elder prepared?
"By the way, I almost forgot about business. Last night I felt that many of the other disciples' vitality was suddenly drained, and the direction of the gathering seemed to be on your side."
He took a sip of wine and said in a deep voice. "But the strange thing is that suddenly the signs stopped."
Ye Qian'an narrowed his eyes slightly after hearing this and answered with a smile.
"Elder, you are overthinking. I am just a handyman disciple. How can I drain the vitality of other disciples?"
Elder Murong narrowed his eyes and smiled.
"Oh yeah?"
"That's it, hiccup~"
